features.description: The core AI surface: prompt agents that read, write, and run code in your project, add context, review changes, and manage threads.
Zed's native agent using Zed-configured models with built-in tools, profiles, skills, instructions, and MCP servers.
Run ACP-integrated agents like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor, or Pi inside the Agent Panel; the agent owns its runtime and auth, and Zed does not charge for them.
Run any agent CLI/TUI in a terminal-backed thread, organized in the Threads Sidebar.
Threads Sidebar (ctrl-alt-j) runs multiple agent threads and Terminal Threads at once, each with its own agent, context, and project.
Ctrl-Enter sends a selection to any configured LLM and replaces it in place.
AI completions as you type, powered by default by Zed's open-source Zeta model; also supports GitHub Copilot, Codestral, and Mercury providers.
Generate commit messages from the Git panel.
Built-in Write, Ask, and Minimal profiles (or custom ones) set the default model and which built-in/MCP tools are available.
Per-tool rules for allow, deny, or confirm behavior on agent tool calls.
Terminal and fetch tool calls run under OS sandboxes (Bubblewrap on Linux; Windows sandboxes are weaker), restricting filesystem writes and outbound network.
Personal and project AGENTS.md as the primary instruction file, with compatibility for .rules, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .clinerules, and .github/copilot-instructions.md.
SKILL.md instruction packages with a built-in /create-skill walkthrough and a Skills Manager (cmd-alt-l).
Supports MCP Tools and Prompts; extensions can provide MCP servers.
Zed-hosted models, provider API keys, existing subscriptions, gateways (OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Amazon Bedrock), and local models.
llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, and local OpenAI-compatible servers.
Use ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, OpenCode, Cursor, and other existing subscriptions as model access.
Hosted frontier models included with Pro, e.g. Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra/Luna, GPT-5.5 pro, GPT-5.4 pro.
Editor free forever (BYOK/external agents); Pro $10/mo with $5 of tokens included and usage-based billing beyond; Student plan with $10/mo credits; Business $30/seat/mo.
Org-wide AI model policies, data governance controls, unified spend visibility, and role-based access.
Real-time collaborative editing included in all plans.
